Would you choose to live in Estonia for its quiet lifestyle and beautiful people, or would the loneliness and empty towns be too much for you? 
#RealLifeInEstonia #EstoniaTravel

comments.author: @raunohurt43
comments.text:
I recommend the HOT ROOM (sauna) to everyone; it teaches endurance.🤠 
In the world of gods where we live! Certainly a good experience...😁

comments.author: @AtlasDiscover1
comments.text: The pristine forests and serene Baltic coastline of Estonia are absolutely breathtaking! The peaceful, untouched natural scenery gives off such a relaxing vibe. I could spend endless days exploring those tranquil woodlands!

comments.author: @Reallifeinsights.26
comments.text: As an introvert, a country where people respect your personal space and half the population lives online sounds like absolute paradise!

replies.author: @PlanetExplorer-DB
replies.text: That combination of personal space, quiet living, and strong digital culture sounds perfect for an introvert!

comments.author: @telehappy_usa
comments.text: I never expected Estonia to feel this peaceful and lonely at the same time. What surprised you most about the country? 👀

replies.author: @raunohurt43
replies.text:
@PlanetExplorer-DB this isolation from the world is quite tedious and boring. You have to be smart.
In the world of gods where we live! Definitely a good experience...💙

replies.author: @PlanetExplorer-DB
replies.text: The contrast between Estonia’s advanced digital society and its quiet forests, empty towns, and reserved lifestyle surprised me most.
